slots.title: Share image: predictions
slots.brief: A betting board for calls: a big split price bar glowing hololive blue (#3fb8f5) on one side and warm orange on the other, floating yes/no ballot tokens, a crystal ball on a small stand reflecting a stock chart, faint probability curves across a dark ink (#0a0c11) background. Flat shapes, halftone bloom. Left 45% calm for the title composited later.
slots.notes: Safe area: centre 1080×566. No text or numbers. Not wired yet: app/predictions/page.tsx and [slug]/page.tsx export no metadata today; add metadata.openGraph.images there once served at /art/og/predictions.png with metadataBase set. A per-market card could later composite the market title over this plate.

slots.title: Predictions: header backdrop
slots.brief: A wide, low strip: a long glowing tote board of probability bars and small yes/no tokens receding to the right, a faint crystal ball silhouette and a few floating ballot slips, soft haze. Dark ink (#0a0c11) with hololive blue (#3fb8f5) and a little warm orange. The left 50% fades to near-black (page title and blurb sit there).
slots.notes: Behind the page header (kicker, title, blurb), which is ~120px tall; the UI masks it so it fades out to the left and bottom. On phones it is cropped to the right. No text or numbers.

slots.title: Predictions: nothing on this tab
slots.brief: An empty betting window: a small ticket booth with its shutter half down, a 'back soon' clock sign with no text on it, a crystal ball resting on the counter showing only swirling mist. Muted blues and greys with a hololive-blue (#3fb8f5) glow in the ball. Flat shapes, halftone.
slots.notes: Above the empty-tab message, ~200px wide, centred. Transparent background.

slots.title: My bets: no open bets
slots.brief: A fresh pad of blank bet slips and a pen on a desk, a single yes/no token balanced on its edge about to fall either way, a tiny crystal ball glinting beside it. Hololive blue (#3fb8f5) and warm orange accents, flat shapes, halftone.
slots.notes: Above 'No open bets. Hit the floor and make a call', ~200px wide. Transparent background.

slots.title: Prediction market: event badge
where: /predictions/[slug] (event markets with no talent or image)
slots.brief: A compact emblem for 'an event call': a crystal ball on a small stand with a tiny up-arrow and down-arrow orbiting it, hololive blue (#3fb8f5) glass, dark outline. Flat, bold, readable at 44px.
slots.notes: Shown in the market header where talent markets show the talent's logo. If a market has a featured_image_url that image is shown instead.

slots.title: Prediction market: the call is in
slots.brief: A judge's gavel mid-strike on a round sound block, a burst of flat impact lines and a few confetti bits, plus a rubber stamp shape beside it. Hololive blue (#3fb8f5) and white with warm wood tones. Flat shapes, halftone.
slots.notes: Beside the big 'The call: YES/NO' verdict, ~96px. The verdict colour comes from the UI, so keep the art neutral.
